summary: Frontend-only test of the Ship's Log 3-line clamp / hover tooltip / per-row expand toggle / master Expand-Collapse all, plus the 3 iteration_101 paper-scan fixes. Seeded TEST_it98_log with 3 extra log rows (700-char x2, 118-char) and temporarily added the same rows (ids 990001-990003) to test-user-pro boat 'main' for the crew view; all removed afterwards. All requested behaviours pass.

design_issues.screen: Ship's Log after 'Expand all log rows'
issues: Expand all adds every visible non-folder row id to logOpen, so short 1-line rows (e.g. 'TEST log A 2024 Mar') also show a Collapse (ChevronsDownUp) icon that does nothing visible. They disappear again on Collapse all. Suggest only rendering ExpandButton when `long` (keep the measured long value) or only adding rows that are long.
Expand icon wrapper uses self-center, so on an expanded long row the icon sits mid-row (owner view keeps it at the top next to edit/delete). Minor alignment inconsistency.

action_items: Optional: don't show the per-row collapse icon on short rows after Expand all (BoatPrep.jsx line ~838 / Checklist.jsx Row `expand` condition).
Optional: top-align the crew-view expand icon (Checklist.jsx tickOnly wrapper self-center -> self-start pt-2).
critical_code_review_comments: Expand all only collects rows in logFolders.visible; rows inside a closed folder stay collapsed when the folder is later opened while the master button reads 'Collapse all'. Acceptable but worth knowing.
ClampText sets title on every Ship's Log row (incl. short ones); harmless duplicate tooltip on short rows.
Paper-scan page date fields use native <input type=date> (pre-existing).
verified: Desktop 1920: 700-char rows data-clamped=true, CSS -webkit-line-clamp 3, height 67px vs 358 scroll, title attr = full text (700 chars); short rows have no expand icon; 118-char row exactly 3 lines -> no icon
checklist-item-expand-<id> aria-expanded false->true shows full text (data-clamped=false, no title), click again re-clamps
Clicking checklist-item-text-<id> still ticks/unticks the row
log-expand-all-btn: 'Expand all log rows' -> all rows open, label 'Collapse all log rows' -> all clamped again
Works with a 2025 year folder open (folder row log-folder-<id> has no expand icon; rows inside expand)
Switching to Leaving Dock: no master button, no expand icons, data-clamped=false; back to Ship's Log -> all collapsed; reload + reopen -> all collapsed
Resize 1920->390: 118-char row gains expand icon (67/134), back to 1920 icon removed
Crew (test_session_free_1 on TEST_Kia Ora shared boat): master button shown, row clamped with tooltip, expand icon present (no edit btn), toggle + master work

Paper scan (mocked paper-log: 1 success, 1 500): while processing review button disabled with opacity 0.5 / cursor not-allowed; Cancel during processing confirm = "Discard the page being read now (its Magic use is already spent)? ..."; after: banner '1 read · 1 didn't work (tap Try again)' with bg-amber-50 text-amber-900; Cancel with done page confirm = 'Discard 1 scanned page? ...'

Crew login with test_session_free_1 lands on shared boat 'TEST_Kia Ora' with a Boat T&C dialog; click 'Not now'. Use `import asyncio` in route handlers for the paper-log mock.
